verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official Proton Pass CLI that supports item and vault CRUD and works in scripts and CI/CD pipelines. Nothing in the pack shows a documented public API (REST, SDK or similar) that a programmatic consumer can call directly. A CLI is a separate interface, so it does not count as the public API this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
